decisions.rationale: The user reviewed the isolated base-chart discrepancy and confirmed that the Excel 0.5 value is a manual legacy entry error. The canonical Showdown 1x value remains unchanged.
evidence: The fixed Showdown TypeChart resolves Water attacking Flying to neutral damage.
The read-only Excel matrix stores 0.5 at 属性克制!L5.
Exactly 18 derived rows containing Flying inherit the same Excel root error.

decisions.rationale: All three Showdown keys and mechanics are distinct. The fixed Chinese source and the read-only Excel Ability list independently agree on 284, 286, and 287, so the collision can be resolved without merging identities or inventing numbers.
evidence: Excel 特性列表 rows 286, 288, and 289 contain the same three numbers and English names.
Showdown data/abilities.ts has separate IDs and mechanics but repeats num 284.

decisions.rationale: Nihil Light is a Future Move with resolved identity but conflicting mechanics. Current scope policy supports retaining its identity and provenance while excluding it from the current stable release until the pinned sources can be reviewed again.
evidence: Showdown marks Nihil Light as Future.
The mechanics conflict is preserved in build-time reports.
The existing stable candidate already excludes quarantined Future mechanics.

decisions.rationale: The two fixed structured upstream sources independently identify Slowpoke and Galarian Slowpoke as the respective predecessors of Slowking, while the read-only Excel row supplies Slowbro for both edges. The canonical graph is therefore retained without changing Excel.
evidence: Showdown data/pokedex.ts gives Slowking prevo Slowpoke and Galarian Slowking prevo Slowpoke-Galar.
pokemon-dataset-zh data/pokemon/0199-呆呆王.json contains two chains whose from value is 呆呆兽, separated by base and Galar form_name evidence.
Excel 全国图鉴!T266 stores 呆壳兽 as the predecessor for both canonical target edges.
decisions.reReviewPolicy: Re-review both exact edges if either pinned upstream commit or the Excel fingerprint changes.

decisions.rationale: The pinned Showdown accuracy true maps to the project's distinct always-hit semantic, while Excel 1 and pokemon-dataset-zh 100 are legacy numeric encodings. Main-series reference displays use a dash rather than numeric 100, so canonical always-hit mechanics remain unchanged.
evidence: Pinned Showdown data/moves.ts#aromaticmist has num 597, accuracy true, PP 20, and target adjacentAlly.
The project maps Showdown true to AccuracySemantic kind always; percent 100 and unknown are separate schema variants.
Excel 招式列表!G598 stores 1, normalized as 100 percent, and pokemon-dataset-zh data/move_list.json#/596 stores accuracy 100.
External main-series reference corroboration reviewed for Round 3 displays Aromatic Mist accuracy as a dash percent, not numeric 100.
decisions.reReviewPolicy: Re-review this exact accuracy field if the pinned Showdown commit, pokemon-dataset-zh commit, Excel fingerprint, or canonical AccuracySemantic policy changes.

decisions.rationale: Take Heart has 10 PP in Pokemon Legends: Arceus and 15 PP in Generation IX Scarlet and Violet. Excel and pokemon-dataset-zh preserve the Generation VIII historical value, while the pinned Showdown record supplies the project's current canonical Generation IX value.
evidence: Pinned Showdown data/moves.ts#takeheart has num 850, accuracy true, PP 15, and target self.
Excel 招式列表!H851 stores PP 10 and pokemon-dataset-zh data/move_list.json#/882 stores PP 10 with generation 8 metadata.
Known mechanics history distinguishes 10 PP in Pokemon Legends: Arceus from 15 PP in Generation IX Scarlet and Violet.
decisions.reReviewPolicy: Re-review this exact PP field if the pinned Showdown commit, pokemon-dataset-zh commit, Excel fingerprint, or canonical current-version policy changes.
